Apple iPad with A16 chip: 11-inch Liquid Retina Display, 512 GB, Wi-Fi 6, 12MP Front/12MP Back Camera, Touch ID — Silver

reviews.quote: The affordable tablet lags behind in the most important area. Pros: fast SoC, hardly any heat dissipation, premium case. Cons: thick bezels, a slow 60 Hz screen, the panel is not completely laminated, only a 12-month guarantee, only a few Bluetooth audio codecs, only USB 2.0.

praises: Half a terabyte in the cheap iPad — offline media libraries, downloaded courses, and large note archives with no iCloud bill (r/ipad)
A16 stays smooth under heavy multitasking; 512GB owners never see the storage-full slowdown
Landscape 12MP front camera + Center Stage remains the best budget video-call combo
Magic Keyboard Folio turns it into a real writing machine for long-form work
8-9h real battery and USB-C display-out make it a viable travel workstation
complaints: $1,409 with keyboard lands within ~$100 of an iPad Air M4 + keyboard on sale — the Air is the better chip, display, and AI story
Non-laminated display at $1,400 total is hard to defend
No Apple Intelligence on the most expensive tier of the budget iPad
USB 2.0 makes moving hundreds of gigabytes off the device painfully slow
Folio keyboard lacks a trackpad and backlight

design_philosophy: The capacity outlier of the base line: buyers choose 512GB here when they want iPad simplicity plus bulk offline storage without Pro pricing. It exposes the base iPad's ceiling — beyond ~$1,300 total, the Air M4 line is usually the smarter Apple.
